description: This file defines the AttendanceDao class, which encapsulates data access methods related to employee attendance records in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, checking overlaps, deleting, and reporting on attendance data, utilizing Doctrine ORM for database operations.

classes.name: AttendanceDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for handling attendance-related database operations, including CRUD, overlap checking, reporting, and configuration validation within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: savePunchRecord
methods.description: Persists an AttendanceRecord entity to the database.

methods.name: getLastPunchRecordByEmployeeNumberAndActionableList
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent AttendanceRecord for an employee filtered by a list of actionable states.

methods.name: checkForPunchOutOverLappingRecords
methods.description: Checks for overlapping punch-out records for an employee at a specified time.

methods.name: checkForPunchInOverLappingRecords
methods.description: Checks for overlapping punch-in records for an employee.

methods.name: checkForPunchInOverLappingRecordsWhenEditing
methods.description: Validates overlapping punch-in records when editing an existing record.

methods.name: checkForPunchInOutOverLappingRecordsWhenEditing
methods.description: Validates overlapping punch-in and punch-out records when editing.

methods.name: getCommonQueryForPunchOutOverlap
methods.description: Helper method to determine overlaps in punch-out times.

methods.name: getCommonQueryForPunchInOverlap
methods.description: Helper method to determine overlaps in punch-in times.

methods.name: getCommonQueryForPunchInOverlap
methods.description: Helper method to determine overlaps in punch-in times during editing, considering record ID.

methods.name: getCommonQueryForPunchInOverlap
methods.description: Helper method to determine overlaps for punch-in records, including optional record ID for editing cases.

methods.name: hasSavedConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if a specific workflow state transition configuration exists.

methods.name: deleteAttendanceRecords
methods.description: Deletes multiple attendance records by their IDs.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordById
methods.description: Retrieves an attendance record by its ID if it is not associated with a purged employee.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordsByEmpNumberAndIds
methods.description: Fetches attendance records for an employee matching a list of record IDs.

methods.name: getLatestAttendanceRecordByEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Returns the most recent attendance record for a given employee.

methods.name: getAttendanceReportCriteriaList
methods.description: Generates a list of attendance reports based on search filters.

methods.name: getAttendanceReportPaginator
methods.description: Provides a paginator for attendance report queries.

methods.name: getAttendanceReportCriteriaListCount
methods.description: Counts the number of attendance report results matching filters.

methods.name: getTotalAttendanceDuration
methods.description: Calculates total attendance duration based on search filters.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of attendance records based on search filters.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordListPaginator
methods.description: Provides a paginator for attendance record queries.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordListQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Creates a query builder for attendance records with applied filters.

methods.name: getCommonQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Applies common filters to the attendance record query builder.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordListCount
methods.description: Counts attendance records matching specified filters.

methods.name: getTotalWorkingTime
methods.description: Retrieves total working time for a set of filters, grouped by employee.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttendanceSummaryList
methods.description: Fetches aggregated attendance summaries for employees.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttendanceSummaryListCount
methods.description: Counts the number of employee attendance summaries.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttendanceSummaryPaginator
methods.description: Provides a paginator for employee attendance summaries.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttendanceSummaryQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Creates a query builder for employee attendance summaries with filters.
